links.note: Final Formative matching Q13 (Lockout procedure) matches column B 'Makes sure machinery or equipment will not start and injure a worker during set-up or clean-up'. CBLM 3 p.38 says the same; the controlling-hazards card teaches lockout.

Short Q56 asks what the evidence guide contains. CBLM 9 p.15 (and CBLM 1 p.16) list: underpinning knowledge, skills and attitude; aspects emphasised in assessment; relationships to other units; required evidence. The paper answer guide (p.7) gives a different list (critical aspects, resource implications, assessment methods, context); card follows the CBLM.

Short Q58 asks what an assessor should ask when evaluating evidence. CBLM 12 p.20 gives the questions to ask for each rule of evidence (sufficient, valid, current, authentic, consistent, recent); the rules-of-evidence card teaches them. The paper answer guide (p.7) also adds 'accurate'.

Short Q66 asks what to do if assessment affects workplace production. CBLM 12 p.15 says the assessment should be stopped when it is having an effect on production. The paper answer guide (p.8) adds: pause and resume at a suitable time or under suitable conditions.

Short Q81 asks for six points in an assessment agreement/process briefing. The paper answer guide (p.10) admits it has no specific list and only suggests a 'typical' one. The closest CBLM content is CBLM 12 p.10 (what to inform the candidate, seven points). Owner to confirm this link.
